_README: Checkable assertions that prose in this repo relies on, validated against the live roster by scripts/verify_facts.py. Add a claim here whenever a note starts steering decisions with a roster fact. Counts drift as the account grows, so aggregate claims carry a tolerance; per-unit gear/relic claims do not.
_why: On 2026-08-17 memory/order66-raid-mechanics.md asserted a squad was 'gear 5-7, zero relics'. The roster said g=13, rt=7 (Relic 5). The wrong fact picked the raid difficulty, the run capped a tier below where it could have, and it was the last of five attempts. Nothing in the repo could have caught that. This file is the thing that catches it.
